doctrine: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology + agentic skills framework for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot CLI and other coding agents. Core workflow: (1) Brainstorming—Socratic design refinement that explores alternatives before coding, saves design document; (2) Git worktrees—Isolated workspace on new branch, runs project setup, verifies clean test baseline; (3) Writing plans—Break work into 2-5 minute bite-sized tasks with exact file paths, complete code, verification steps; (4) Subagent-driven development—Fresh subagent per task, two-stage review (spec compliance, then code quality), or batch execution with human checkpoints; (5) Test-driven development—RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle: failing test, watch fail, minimal code, watch pass, commit, delete code written before tests; (6) Code review—Pre-review checklist, severity-based issue reporting; (7) Git branch finishing—Verify tests, present merge/PR/keep/discard options, cleanup worktree. TDD emphasis: tests first, always. Systematic over ad-hoc. Simplicity as primary goal. Evidence-based decisions. 43K+ GitHub stars, officially in Anthropic's marketplace as of 2 weeks prior to video. Installing via Anthropic marketplace: /plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official. Core commands: /brainstorm, /write-plan, /execute-plan. Skills library covers testing, debugging, collaboration, meta. Composable skill system triggers automatically. Superpowers framework designed to enforce disciplined development without manual intervention.
